owner_decision: September 9, 2026: human review is for headline content and for replacing figures already on the site. Additions from credible authorities are applied to the site automatically under the rules below, each one recorded as a catalog_change event with its commit.
always_human: homepage.json, editorial selections and any headline card
replacing, correcting or superseding a figure already on the site
metric definitions, targets and chart configuration
source policy, excerpt permission and discovery permissions
stage changes on accepted projects and any object that already exists
